answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 27488 Country: India Title: I angerly on cell phone said 3 talaqs to my wife but she claimed that she didn't even listened single word and nobody was arround both of us. please tell me whether talaq took place or not? Question: Salamualaikum, I angerly on cell phone said 3 talaqs to my wife but she claimed that she didn't even listened single word and nobody was arround both of us. please tell me whether talaq took place or not? Answer ID: 27488 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1787/507/TL=1431) If you have given three talaqs to your wife, all the three took place and she became haram for you after being bayinah mughallazah. She will be free to marry anywhere she likes after her iddah is over. It is not necessary for talaq to take place that the wife hears it or the witnesses are present. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
